rows.en:
(I asked Nanase out to thank her
for the other day, but...)

Oh, \p-san.
Sorry to keep you waiting.

No, no, I just got here too.
Well then, let's go.

Okay, today's my thanks for your help the other day.
It's my treat, so order whatever you like, okay?

Oh, is that all you want?
That's pretty ordinary...
Look, they've got a Galaxy Parfait and stuff, see?
rows.notes: Female. Galaxy Parfait: menu item, not in the glossary (as c11616).

rows.en:
Huh, I see.
Then isn't working at Nyan-Nyan perfect for you?
Right, and even more so if it's sweets, huh.
I see. That really is a tough problem...
I guess you might be right.
Oh, no, today was my idea in the first place...
Oh, that might be nice!

(She steamrolled me, but I'm kinda looking
forward to it~)
(Think I'll go to Silver Moon with Nanase again.)
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders. Trailing blank line (full-width space) dropped as in c11799.

Nah, I just got here myself...
Well then, let's get going.

Phew.
Tea and cake really are delicious, aren't they?

Yeah, they sure are.
Of course, Nyan-Nyan's dim sum is great too!
Of course! Naturally!

Oh, look at the time.
I'd better head home soon.
Yeah. Well then, see you at school.
(That turned into a nice, laid-back time.)
Oh, \p-san, sorry to keep you waiting.

No, no, I just got here too...
Well then, let's get going.

Yeah, they sure are.
Of course, Nyan-Nyan's dim sum is great too!
Yeah. Well then, see you at school.

(I took Nanase up on her offer and came
to Nyan-Nyan, but...)
Welco...
rows.notes: x2, Nanase cuts off her greeting on seeing the player; full greeting c00702 is 'Welcome!'.

rows.en:
Oh, \p-kun.
Sorry, we're a little busy right now,
so could you sit at this table and wait?
(Hmm, looks like she's got her hands full...)
A party of four? Right this way, please.
Yes, just a moment, pleeease!
(Business sure is booming...)
I'm so sorryyy, it's kinda busy today...

Nah, I'm fine.
What about you, Nanase? Are you okay?
Yes, things have just calmed down.
Good work.
Now then, let's start over...

Welcome to Nyan-Nyan!
Will it be just one today?
Just kidding~
So, what'll you have? Today it's my treat!

Hmm, let's see...
Then I'll have whatever you recommend, Nanase.

Certainly!
Then I'll bring you Nyan-Nyan's specialty,
the "maguro bun"!
Okay, I'll have that then!
Phew, that was delicious!
How was it? Nyan-Nyan's "maguro bun"?

Oh, Nanase.
Are you done with work already?
Yes, it's time for my shift to end.

I see. Good work.
But seeing you really hard at work like that
is pretty impressive.
Huh? Oh, no, it's just normal.
(Nanase really takes her work seriously.)

Oh, \p-san.
Sorry, we're a little busy right now,
so could you sit at this table and wait?
(Hmm, looks like she's got her hands full...)
(Business seems to be booming...)

No, no, I'm fine.
What about you, Nanase? Are you okay?
Good work~

Hmm, let's see...
Then I'll have whatever you recommend, Nanase!
Mmm, that was delicious~!

I see. Good work.
But seeing you really hard at work like that
is super impressive.
(Nanase really takes her work seriously~)

(Okay, maybe I'll go to Nyan-Nyan again...
I wonder if Nanase's working hard?)

Oh, \p-kun.
Welcome!
The place is packed again today, huh.

Yes, I'll come take your order shortly,
so please wait at your table... Just kidding.
Good work at your part-time job.

Well, today's actually one of the better days.
When it's really busy... ugh...
Yeah, that's a popular place for you.
(Nanase's working hard at her job too.)

(All right, think I'll go to Nyan-Nyan again...
I wonder if Nanase's working hard?)
